content: We need to determine SMILES of an organic molecule given a sample, but we have no data. Likely need to retrieve NMR or other spectra to deduce structure. We have tools: retrieve spectra? There's "proton_nmr_spectra", "carbon_nmr_spectra", "ir_spectra", "mass_spectrometry_spectra", "hsqc_nmr_spectra". But we need to know which sample? The prompt doesn't give any data. Maybe we need to request spectra? The system likely has a sample "at hand". So we can call e.g., proton_nmr_spectra to get data. Then interpret to deduce structure. Let's start by retrieving proton NMR.
